---
title: "greta benchmark suite"
format: gfm
params:
  results: ""
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(bench)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(rlang)
library(knitr)

if (!nzchar(params$results)) {
  stop("no results file given - see suite/report.R", call. = FALSE)
}
res <- readRDS(params$results)

timings <- res$timings
under_test <- res$branches[[1]]
reference <- res$branches[[2]]

# relative within each model x task cell: different tasks are different work,
# and normalising across them would say nothing
relative <- timings |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(task = as.character(expression)) |>
  group_by(model, task) |>
  mutate(rel_median = as.numeric(median) / min(as.numeric(median))) |>
  ungroup()
```

`r under_test` against `r reference`, `r res$n_iterations` iterations per cell.
A ratio below 1 means the branch under test is faster.

## Relative median, by model and task

```{r}
#| label: relative
relative |>
  select(model, task, branch, median) |>
  mutate(median = as.numeric(median)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = branch, values_from = median) |>
  mutate(ratio = round(.data[[under_test]] / .data[[reference]], 3)) |>
  transmute(model, task, ratio) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = task, values_from = ratio) |>
  kable(align = "r")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-suite
#| fig-cap: "Every iteration, by model and task. Overlapping clouds mean the difference is not resolved at this iteration count - raise GRETA_BENCH_ITERATIONS rather than reading the medians."
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
timings |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(task = as.character(expression)) |>
  select(model, task, branch, time) |>
  unnest(time) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.numeric(time), y = branch)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, colour = "#F8766D") +
  facet_grid(model ~ task, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(signif(1000 * x, 2), "ms")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

## Is the difference resolved?

A ratio is only worth reading if the effect is larger than the spread. This
compares them per cell:

```{r}
#| label: resolution
timings |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(task = as.character(expression)) |>
  select(model, task, branch, time) |>
  unnest(time) |>
  mutate(ms = 1000 * as.numeric(time)) |>
  summarise(median = median(ms), sd = sd(ms), .by = c(model, task, branch)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = branch, values_from = c(median, sd)) |>
  transmute(
    model, task,
    `difference (ms)` = round(.data[[paste0("median_", reference)]] -
                              .data[[paste0("median_", under_test)]], 1),
    `worst sd (ms)` = round(pmax(.data[[paste0("sd_", reference)]],
                                 .data[[paste0("sd_", under_test)]]), 1),
    resolved = if_else(
      abs(.data[[paste0("median_", reference)]] - .data[[paste0("median_", under_test)]]) >
        pmax(.data[[paste0("sd_", reference)]], .data[[paste0("sd_", under_test)]]),
      "yes", "not at this n"
    )
  ) |>
  kable(align = "r")
```

## Environment

```{r}
#| label: provenance
platform <- res$provenance$platform
packages <- as_tibble(res$provenance$packages)

bind_rows(
  tibble(
    item = c("run at", "OS", "system", "CPU", "cores detected", "R",
             "iterations per cell"),
    value = c(res$provenance$run_at, platform$os, platform$system,
              res$provenance$cpu, as.character(res$provenance$cores),
              platform$version, as.character(res$n_iterations))
  ),
  packages |>
    transmute(item = paste("R package:", package),
              value = paste0(ondiskversion, " (", source, ")")),
  tibble(item = paste("greta,", names(res$shas)),
         value = sprintf("[`%s`](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta/commit/%s)",
                         unname(res$shas), unname(res$shas)))
) |>
  set_names(c("", "")) |>
  kable()
```
